cards.card_text: As they flee down from Beth-horon toward Azekah, the LORD throws large hailstones down on them from the sky.
cards.verse_text: As they fled before Israel along the descent from Beth-horon to Azekah, the LORD cast down on them large hailstones from the sky, and more of them were killed by the hailstones than by the swords of the Israelites.
cards.snippet: …descent from Beth-horon to Azekah, the LORD cast down on them large hailstones from the sky, and more of them were killed by the hailstones…

cards.card_text: True or false: Israel's swords kill more of the fleeing armies than the hailstones do.

cards.card_text: Hailstones and coals of fire Rain and rivers of water Wind and clouds of dust
cards.verse_text: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced—hailstones and coals of fire.
cards.snippet: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced—hailstones and coals of fire.

cards.card_text: Fire and hailstones Locusts and drought Darkness and frogs
cards.verse_text: And the LORD will cause His majestic voice to be heard and His mighty arm to be revealed, striking in angry wrath with a flame of consuming fire, and with cloudburst, storm, and hailstones.
cards.snippet: …wrath with a flame of consuming fire, and with cloudburst, storm, and hailstones.

cards.card_text: God says He'll pour out torrents of rain, hailstones, fire and sulfur on Gog.
cards.verse_text: I will pour out torrents of rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.

cards.card_text: Then great hailstones, almost a hundred pounds each, rain down from above.
cards.verse_text: And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above.
cards.snippet: And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above.
